title: Sparkly jack-o'-lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD54F" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF9800" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sparkGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity="1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFF176" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Ambient glow behind pumpkin -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="38" fill="url(#glow)" opacity="0.35"/>

  <!-- Pumpkin body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="63" rx="30" ry="23" fill="#FF8F00"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="63" rx="25" ry="23" fill="#FFA726"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="63" rx="19" ry="23" fill="#FFB74D"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="63" rx="12" ry="22" fill="#FFCC80"/>

  <!-- Pumpkin ridges (lighter shading) -->
  <path d="M35 48 Q33 63 35 78" stroke="#FF8F00" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M65 48 Q67 63 65 78" stroke="#FF8F00" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M42 45 Q41 63 42 81" stroke="#FFB74D" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.4"/>
  <path d="M58 45 Q59 63 58 81" stroke="#FFB74D" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x="47" y="34" width="6" height="10" rx="3" fill="#6D4C41"/>
  <rect x="48" y="34" width="2" height="10" rx="1" fill="#8D6E63"/>

  <!-- Stem vine curl -->
  <path d="M53 36 Q60 32 58 26 Q56 21 61 20" stroke="#7CB342" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Left leaf -->
  <path d="M47 44 Q38 36 32 40 Q36 44 44 45 Z" fill="#7CB342"/>
  <path d="M47 44 Q38 36 32 40" stroke="#9CCC65" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Right leaf -->
  <path d="M55 43 Q64 35 70 38 Q66 43 58 44 Z" fill="#8BC34A"/>
  <path d="M55 43 Q64 35 70 38" stroke="#AED581" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Eyes - glowing triangles -->
  <polygon points="38,54 44,64 32,64" fill="#FFEB3B"/>
  <polygon points="62,54 68,64 56,64" fill="#FFEB3B"/>
  <polygon points="39,56 43,63 35,63" fill="#FFC107" opacity="0.5"/>
  <polygon points="61,56 65,63 57,63" fill="#FFC107" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Nose - small triangle -->
  <polygon points="50,63 47,69 53,69" fill="#FFEB3B"/>
  <polygon points="50,65 48.5,68.5 51.5,68.5" fill="#FFC107" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Mouth - smiling jack-o'-lantern grin -->
  <path d="M34 73 L38 69 L42 74 L46 69 L50 74 L54 69 L58 74 L62 69 L66 73 Q50 82 34 73 Z" fill="#FFEB3B"/>
  <path d="M36 74 L38 71 L41 74.5 L44 71 L47 74.5 L50 71 L53 74.5 L56 71 L59 74.5 L62 71 L64 74 Q50 79 36 74 Z" fill="#FFC107" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Sparkle 1 - top left -->
  <g transform="translate(18, 28)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="url(#sparkGlow)" opacity="0.7"/>
    <path d="M0,-7 L1.5,-1.5 L7,0 L1.5,1.5 L0,7 L-1.5,1.5 L-7,0 L-1.5,-1.5 Z" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 2 - top right -->
  <g transform="translate(80, 22)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="5" fill="url(#sparkGlow)" opacity="0.6"/>
    <path d="M0,-6 L1.2,-1.2 L6,0 L1.2,1.2 L0,6 L-1.2,1.2 L-6,0 L-1.2,-1.2 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 3 - lower left -->
  <g transform="translate(14, 78)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="4.5" fill="url(#sparkGlow)" opacity="0.6"/>
    <path d="M0,-5 L1,-1 L5,0 L1,1 L0,5 L-1,1 L-5,0 L-1,-1 Z" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 4 - lower right -->
  <g transform="translate(86, 80)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="4" fill="url(#sparkGlow)" opacity="0.5"/>
    <path d="M0,-4.5 L0.9,-0.9 L4.5,0 L0.9,0.9 L0,4.5 L-0.9,0.9 L-4.5,0 L-0.9,-0.9 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 5 - small top center -->
  <g transform="translate(50, 12)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="3.5" fill="url(#sparkGlow)" opacity="0.6"/>
    <path d="M0,-4 L0.8,-0.8 L4,0 L0.8,0.8 L0,4 L-0.8,0.8 L-4,0 L-0.8,-0.8 Z" fill="#FFF59D"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 6 - tiny left mid -->
  <g transform="translate(10, 52)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="3" fill="url(#sparkGlow)" opacity="0.5"/>
    <path d="M0,-3.5 L0.7,-0.7 L3.5,0 L0.7,0.7 L0,3.5 L-0.7,0.7 L-3.5,0 L-0.7,-0.7 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 7 - tiny right mid -->
  <g transform="translate(90, 50)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="3" fill="url(#sparkGlow)" opacity="0.5"/>
    <path d="M0,-3.5 L0.7,-0.7 L3.5,0 L0.7,0.7 L0,3.5 L-0.7,0.7 L-3.5,0 L-0.7,-0.7 Z" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx="25" cy="18" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="15" r="1.5" fill="#FFF59D" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="88" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="90" r="1.8" fill="#FFF59D" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="92" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="8" cy="40" r="1.3" fill="#FFF9C4" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="93" cy="65" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="15" cy="68" r="1" fill="#FFF59D" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="38" r="1.2" fill="#FFF9C4" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
